title: IRDAI Partners with IPAI to Eliminate Dark Patterns in Insurance Sector
summary: Partners with Institute of Public Auditors of India to curb misselling on digital insurance portals.

blocks.content: Partners with Institute of Public Auditors of India to curb misselling on digital insurance portals.

items: Regulatory Objective: Monitors dark patterns and forced add-on sales on digital insurance apps.
Implementation Alignment: Follows RBI's anti-misselling framework effective January 1, 2027.
